raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 30 restated rows (record_version=2) for txn_ids already delivered as version 1. silver_transactions keeps every version, so those transactions are duplicated and the gold aggregates are inflated. The fix keeps only the latest record_version per txn_id, then applies the POSTED filter, assuming the standard latest-version-wins rule since the evidence does not state it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
